name: Inverse Opacity Calculation
definition: A technique to solve for the ray parameter $t$ given a target cumulative density value $y$, used in inverse opacity sampling. It involves inverting the integral of density along a ray.
summary: Inverse Opacity Calculation is a differentiable method for generating importance samples in volume rendering by inverting the cumulative distribution function, enabling direct sampling from transmittance estimates with better numerical stability than standard hierarchical sampling.
